entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-09-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread reports positive deltas for no-inline SpinWait-only intervals on macOS ARM64 #134724
  • JIT: missing vzeroupper before direct calls to the BulkMoveWithWriteBarrierInternal FCALL #134723
  • [maccatalyst][CoreCLR] Fault while logging the fatal-error call stack spins in PAL_DispatchException instead of terminating #134720
  • [wasm][R2R] Give the hidden generic context its own token in Wasm signature strings #134716
  • Check that every debugger IPC event type is sized by `DbgTransportSession::GetEventSize` #134715
  • Linux: debugger transport sends DB_IPCE_RESOLVE_UPDATE_METADATA_* events without their payload, crashing the debuggee #134714
  • Floating-point formatting: small-integer shortcut and bounds-check-free table reads for the unrounded scaling path (#131068) #134712
  • ILVerify false positive: StackUnderflow at the start of an exception filter nested inside a finally handler #134711
  • [browser][Mono] Open-instance delegate to an interface method crashes in mono_class_interface_offset_with_variance #134707
  • [aw] CI Outer-Loop Failure Scanner failed #134706
  • [aw] CI Outer-Loop Failure Scanner — Feedback hit engine rate limit (HTTP 429) #134705
  • [aw] CI Outer-Loop Failure Fixer hit engine rate limit (HTTP 429) #134704
  • Parallel short-lived DeflateStream compressors: page-fault storms on .NET 10 (Windows x64), none on .NET 8 #134700
  • NativeAOT drops reachable interface GVM implementation behind shape dispatch #134698
  • Crash: access violation in coreclr!PgoManager::getPgoInstrumentationResults during tier-1 background JIT (Windows x86) #134695
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: JIT/opt/GuardedDevirtualization/badinlinee returns 101 on composite-R2R windows-arm64 gcstress #134694
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: JIT/opt/Vectorization/AvxState emits forbidden vzeroupper on x64 (X64-NOT FileCheck) #134693
  • [ci-scan] Build break: Mono MiniFullAOT amd64 assertion compiling JIT/Regression_ro_2 (exit 134) #134692
  • Tensor<T> slice pinning starts at the parent array instead of the slice #134691

Closed

  • Simple modulo into switch expression throws division by zero exception #134725
  • NET11-RC1 Conversion from double to decimal loosing precision #134722
  • Type-event cache lifetime race can crash CoreCLR while tracing #134242
